newsitem.title: USA: Cigna again extends Healthsource bid.
newsitem.headline: Cigna again extends Healthsource bid.

text.p: CIGNA Corp said Thursday its CHC Acquisition Corp unit is extending until May 30 its offer to buy all the outstanding shares of stock of Healthsource Inc for $21.75 a share.

The offer was originally scheduled to expire on April 2 but was extended until April 30, 1997. CIGNA said it is extending the offer because certain state regulatory approvals have not yet been obtained.
According to IBJ Schroder Bank & Trust Company, the depositary for the offer, more than 55 million shares of of Healthsource Inc had been tendered as of the close of business on April 30, 1997.
